Where do you look when life gets hard? Kevin has a hack.

Kevin Trudeau says the simple hack for overcoming adversity is where you keep your eye. Not on the problem, but on the dream, on what you want, on your goal.

He says that when you keep your eye on the dream, you'll overcome the problem, because you become what you think about most of the time.

Where is your eye right now: the problem or the goal?
